caption:
Every fresher's resume has the same skills section. Recruiters skim past it.

What stands out is a result: what you changed, how you did it, and a number that shows it worked.

Format for each project bullet:
Did X, using Y, which improved Z (with a number).

No real numbers yet? Measure your own project with Lighthouse before and after a change. Now you have one.

Rewrite one bullet today and post it in the comments. I'll give feedback on a few.

For Best Frontend Resources visit https://allahabadi.dev created by Frontend Master

#javascript #frontend #reactjs #nodejs #webdevelopment
altText:
Your resume is not a list of technologies.

"React, Redux, Tailwind" says nothing.

"Cut page load from 6s to 2s by lazy-loading images" says everything.
